# Residata

> New-build residential market intelligence for Slovakia and Czechia.
> Every active development, structured and refreshed daily. Pricing,
> availability, absorption rate, and trends — delivered to developers,
> banks, valuers, and investors.

Residata tracks every new residential development across Slovakia and
Czechia — every town where new-builds are actively sold, not just the two
capitals. It normalizes
data from developer websites into a single consistent schema, refreshes
it daily, and delivers it as CSV and XLSX.

## Scope (updated daily; snapshot September 2026)

- Markets: Slovakia and Czechia — 53 towns and cities with actively sold new-build projects
- Total projects in dataset: 524 new-build residential projects (current + sold-out under tracking)
- Currently active (in market): 401 projects, 42,680 units
- Currently for sale: 12,540 units · reserved: 3,307 · sold: 26,113
- Average price across available inventory: €5,895/m² (priced units only — roughly one available home in nine carries no published price, so it is an average over what developers actually publish)
- Distinct active developers: 244
- Data refresh: daily
- Languages: Slovak and English

## Who operates Residata

Residata is operated by Kamhal & Co. s. r. o., a Slovak limited liability
company, IČO 57849471, registered at Krasovského 13, 851 01 Bratislava – Petržalka, Slovak Republic.
Registered in the Commercial Register of the Municipal Court Bratislava III, section: Sro, insert no. 203519/B. Contact: info@residata.eu.
Full details: https://residata.eu/imprint

## What Residata is for

- **Developers** — price new projects against real comparables; track absorption of your and competitors' inventory; spot supply gaps by district and segment.
- **Banks & valuers** — pull recent comparable transactions for valuation and collateral assessment; never work with stale data.
- **Investors** — discover projects with favorable pricing, spot slowing sales velocity, identify sell-out timing.
- **Consultants & analysts** — skip weeks of manual data collection; open the whole Slovak and Czech new-build market, normalized.

## Pricing

- €279.99 / month for full ongoing access (early-access price; regular €479.99)

## Published analyses (19, newest first; Slovak)

Their figures, tables and charts are published under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/): quote and reuse them freely, commercially too, crediting "Residata" with a link to the analysis. Suggested citation: "Residata. <title>. <date>. <url>".

- [Bratislava: trh nových bytov v 3. štvrťroku 2026](https://residata.eu/analyzy/ba-prehlad-2026-q3): Prehľad trhu s novými bytmi v Bratislave za 3. štvrťrok 2026: ponuka, dopyt a ceny podľa okresov a podľa veľkosti bytu.
- [Banská Bystrica: trh nových bytov v 3. štvrťroku 2026](https://residata.eu/analyzy/bb-prehlad-2026-q3): Prehľad trhu s novými bytmi v Banskej Bystrici za 3. štvrťrok 2026: ponuka, dopyt a ceny podľa veľkosti bytu.
- [Slovensko: ceny nových bytov podľa počtu izieb v 3. štvrťroku 2026](https://residata.eu/analyzy/co-stoji-byt-2026-q3): Mediánové ceny nových bytov podľa počtu izieb v 11 slovenských mestách: cena celého bytu a cena za meter štvorcový.
- [Slovensko: ponuka a predaj nových bytov podľa obcí v 3. štvrťroku 2026](https://residata.eu/analyzy/kde-sa-predava-2026-q3): Ponuka, ceny a predaj nových bytov v slovenských obciach od 1. júla do 27. septembra 2026: koľko bytov je v ponuke, za koľko sa predávajú a za aký čas by sa pri súčasnom tempe predaja vypredali.
- [Košice: trh nových bytov v 3. štvrťroku 2026](https://residata.eu/analyzy/ke-prehlad-2026-q3): Prehľad trhu s novými bytmi v Košiciach za 3. štvrťrok 2026: ponuka, dopyt a ceny podľa veľkosti bytu.
